toolbar.right: Move node once to the right
toolbar.rightSmart: Move one node to the right with smart mode

status.noPreviousSibling: Move Right: the section has no previous section to move into.
status.cannotLift: Move Left: the section is already at the top level of its body.
status.noNextSibling: Merge: the section has no following section to merge with.
status.lastSection: A body must keep at least one section.
status.lastBody: The book must keep at least one body.
status.cannotDelete: This element cannot be deleted from the tree.
status.notFound: The selected element is no longer in the document.
status.invalidResult: The operation would break the document structure.

moveRight.description: Make the selected section a child of the previous section

moveWithChildren.description: Move the selected section with its children into the previous section

moveLeft.description: Lift the selected section to the level of its parent

merge.description: Merge the selected section with the following section

view.description: Show the selected element in the Body view

viewSource.description: Show the selected element in the Source view
